answer: Trust-flow conservation resists sybils: total trust an identity can PASS ONWARD is capped at the trust it has RECEIVED from the honest core, so a sybil cannot manufacture outflow it never received. A marble cluster across the delta receives almost nothing from the real graph, so it has almost nothing to forward among its own dune of fakes — trust is conserved, not minted. Honest well-endorsed nodes have real inflow to redistribute; a fake region starts at zero inflow and conservation keeps its internal shuffling worthless.
